scope.inclusion_criteria: Human DLB genetic association findings for APOE, SNCA and GBA1 from three original studies. Includes a comparison of APOE ε4 in autopsy-defined groups with low or absent Alzheimer’s co-pathology.
limitations: Selective coverage of human genetic associations in DLB. Case definitions, Alzheimer’s co-pathology thresholds, controls, and analysis methods vary by study.
Variant-level case–control associations do not establish mechanisms, pathway activity, individual disease probabilities or treatment effects.
Mondo and HGNC supply disease and gene identity. The cited papers supply the association findings. Participant overlap across papers was not checked.
Reading covered the cited methods, results and tables. The Kaivola correction and notice metadata were checked. Independent scientific review is a future milestone.

conflicts.label: APOE ε4 in DLB with low Alzheimer’s changes
conflicts.comparison: Tsuang 2013 reported higher odds with APOE ε4 (OR 6.1, 95% CI 3.5–10.5). Kaivola 2022 did not detect an association in its low or absent co-pathology group (OR 0.75, 95% CI 0.43–1.30). Both used a carrier model and autopsy-defined cases. They set different pathology thresholds and used different controls.
context_differences: Pathology groups. Tsuang classified all Alzheimer’s changes below its high threshold as low. Kaivola required Braak 0–II and CERAD 0–A for its low group and modeled intermediate changes separately.

Controls. Tsuang used 269 autopsied controls with low or absent Alzheimer’s changes, no Lewy body changes, and no cognitive impairment at their last evaluation. Kaivola used 2,928 neurologically healthy controls aged at least 50. APOE ε4 carrier counts were 37 and 657, respectively.
Models. Tsuang adjusted the multinomial model for age at death and sex. Kaivola’s subgroup methods identify genetic principal components 1, 2 and 6 for the low-pathology contrast.
The observed differences can guide source reading. The studies do not establish which design choices explain the estimates, equivalence or independent replication.

review.rationale: The case and control inclusion rules, carrier counts, model terms and two reported estimates were checked at the named locators. No common reanalysis or participant-level overlap check was performed.
